methods.name: arca_status
methods.summary: Node status: the API version, the node id, the mode, the uptime, whether Incus answers and the last applied sequence number.

methods.name: node_metrics
methods.summary: Host metrics of the node: the latest sample and the mean over the requested minutes.

methods.name: watch_report
methods.summary: Every instance in every project with its ownership class, and the drift between marks and desired state.

methods.name: token_list
methods.summary: The interim API tokens by id and scope. Never a secret or a hash.

methods.name: journal_list
methods.summary: The newest record for each effect in the journal, paged by effect id. It names only the intent and object fields, never a pre-image or inverse.

methods.name: plan_list
methods.summary: The delete plans and action proposals waiting for an owner's approval. Delete plans carry the exact statement the owner signs; action proposals carry their action, arguments and kernel-built summary.

methods.name: action_propose
methods.summary: Records an inert service, database, GPU assignment, storage or snapshot action proposal for the owner to approve with a passkey. Nothing changes until the owner approves it.

methods.name: plan_decline
methods.summary: Declines a waiting delete plan. Its objects are retained, and the decline is final.

methods.name: approval_submit
methods.summary: Submits an owner's approval for a waiting delete plan, which deletes the plan's objects once. The approval is never echoed.

methods.name: action_approve
methods.summary: Submits an owner's passkey approval for a waiting action proposal, which runs its action once. The approval is checked by this kernel's own verifier and never echoed; an approval page on the same machine relays a linked host's approvals here.

methods.name: peer_keys_sync
methods.summary: Keeps the owner passkeys of the page host `approval.peerKeys` names, for action approvals only. The first set is kept as is; a changed set needs a passkey approval by a key already kept, and without one the answer is the statement to sign. Lines are never echoed.

methods.name: alerts_list
methods.summary: The node's alerts: the firing ones, those whose data is unknown, the disabled rules, the recent resolves, and the store's health.

methods.name: ontology_query
methods.summary: The ownership, status and outgoing calls for an item in Arca's public ontology.

methods.name: service_remove

schema.description: The owner's approval: <base64 statement>.<base64 signature>.
The service name (1-40 of a-z, 0-9 and inner "-", starting with a letter).

methods.summary: Remove a service, its links, its ACL and its secrets, with the owner's signed approval.

methods.name: service_connect

schema.description: The consumer: the service whose environment gets the provider's variables.
The provider: the service whose first port the link opens.

env.description: The environment variable names, never their values.

methods.summary: Link a consumer to a provider: the provider's network ACL lets the consumer's address reach its first port, and nothing else, and the consumer's environment gets what the provider's template provides (DATABASE_URL, say); the environment applies on its next start. Returns the variable names only.

methods.name: service_disconnect

schema.description: The consumer: the service whose environment gets the provider's variables.
The provider: the service whose first port the link opens.

env.description: The environment variable names, never their values.

methods.summary: Remove a link: the provider's ACL rule for the consumer goes, and so do the variables it gave the consumer (applied on its next start). Returns their names.

methods.name: service_secret_set

schema.description: The secret's name, one of the template's secrets.
The service name (1-40 of a-z, 0-9 and inner "-", starting with a letter).
The secret, 8 to 4096 characters.

methods.summary: Set one of a service's secrets (its template lists them). Write-only: no tool, log or audit row shows it again. The service's environment, and its consumers', is updated for their next start.

methods.name: service_publish

schema.description: The owner's approval: <base64 statement>.<base64 signature>.
The service name.
Where the dash is published: "tailnet", the only reach there is.

node.description: The tailnet node the dash is served from: arca-<name>.

url.description: Its address on the tailnet: https://<node>.<tailnet>.ts.net:8443/ (no dash token: the dash asks for its own).

methods.summary: Publish a service's dash on the owner's tailnet (droidd's own) and nowhere else: the service joins it as its own node, arca-<name> (tag:arca-svc), and serves HTTPS on port 8443 only, to its dash. Needs the service's tailscale_authkey secret (the owner's tagged, pre-approved Tailscale auth key, service_secret_set) and the owner's signed approval (arca-approve, action publish, target the service, its arguments' digest), which an agent asks the owner for and relays. Returns the node and its https address.

methods.name: service_unpublish

schema.description: The service name.

methods.summary: Take a service's dash off the tailnet: it stops serving 8443, its node logs out and leaves the tailnet, and tailscaled stops. Runs whether or not a publish finished.

The card's PCI address, such as 0000:01:00.0 or 01:00.0. It is the card's identity.
The Incus instance name.

methods.summary: Attach a physical GPU card to an Incus instance, by PCI address, with the owner's signed approval. A card bound to vfio-pci is refused for a container.

methods.name: gpu_detach

The Incus instance name.
The card's PCI address, such as 0000:01:00.0 or 01:00.0. It is the card's identity.
The Incus instance name.

methods.summary: Detach a physical GPU card from an Incus instance, by PCI address, with the owner's signed approval.

methods.name: storage_list
methods.summary: The host's disks, each with a plain role (system, snapshots, in use or free) and what it may be offered as, and the Incus storage pools with their used and total space.

methods.name: storage_add

schema.description: The one-shot execution grant an approved action proposal arms. A direct call carries none that works.
The storage pool name (1-32 of a-z, 0-9 and inner "-", starting with a letter).
A whole free disk, such as sdb or /dev/sdb. Incus wipes and formats it as btrfs; the pool is named arca-snapshots-<name> (at most 32 characters).
A folder on a mounted disk that is not a system disk. The pool lives in <path>/arca-pool, which Arca makes (empty, 0700) when the approved add runs; Arca must be able to write in the folder.

methods.summary: Add snapshot storage, with the owner's signed approval: a folder on a mounted disk, or a whole free disk that Incus wipes and formats as the pool arca-snapshots-<name>. A system disk, a member disk, a disk that holds snapshots and a mounted disk are refused as a whole-disk target.

methods.name: snapshot_create

schema.description: The one-shot execution grant an approved action proposal arms. A direct call carries none that works.
The storage pool name (1-32 of a-z, 0-9 and inner "-", starting with a letter).
The source's Incus project.
The Incus instance name.
The snapshot's name, set by the kernel.
A source volume's pool.
The source custom volume.

methods.summary: Copy one app or data volume onto snapshot storage, with the owner's signed approval. The copy lives in the arcak-snapshots project, never starts on its own, and the source is never changed.

methods.name: snapshot_list
methods.summary: Every snapshot copy in the arcak-snapshots project: its source, pool, size and when it was made.

methods.name: snapshot_delete

schema.description: The one-shot execution grant an approved action proposal arms. A direct call carries none that works.
The snapshot's name.
The snapshot's pool.

methods.summary: Delete one snapshot copy from the arcak-snapshots project, with the owner's signed approval. Nothing outside that project is touched.
